Verses.VerseAr: اِقۡتَرَبَتِ السَّاعَةُ وَانشَقَّ الۡقَمَرُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Last Hour has drawn near and the moon has split into two.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنۡ يَّرَوۡا اٰيَةً يُّعۡرِضُوۡا وَيَقُوۡلُوۡا سِحۡرٌ مُّسۡتَمِرٌّ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And if they (the disbelievers) see a Sign (miracle) they turn their faces away and say: ‘This is the powerful magic ever running down through ages.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَكَذَّبُوۡا وَاتَّبَعُوۡۤا اَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ‌ وَكُلُّ اَمۡرٍ مُّسۡتَقِرٌّ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they have rejected (the Truth even now) and followed their vain desires. And everything (that has been promised) is to take place at the appointed time.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاَنۡۢبَآءِ مَا فِيۡهِ مُزۡدَجَرٌۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And indeed the news has come to them (of the earlier communities) containing lessons of warning and admonition (on disbelief and disobedience).

Verses.VerseAr: حِكۡمَةٌ  ۢ بَالِغَةٌ‌ فَمَا تُغۡنِ النُّذُرُۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (This Qur’an) is perfect intellect and reason. Are the Warners still not of any benefit?

Verses.VerseAr: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ‌ۘ يَوۡمَ يَدۡعُ الدَّاعِ اِلٰى شَىۡءٍ نُّكُرٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So turn your face away from them. The Day when the caller (angel) will call towards the most detestable thing (the expanse of the last assembly),

Verses.VerseAr: خُشَّعًا اَبۡصَارُهُمۡ يَخۡرُجُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡاَجۡدَاثِ كَاَنَّهُمۡ جَرَادٌ مُّنۡتَشِرٌۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: With eyes cast down, they will come out of their graves like scattered locusts,

Verses.VerseAr: مُّهۡطِعِيۡنَ اِلَى الدَّاعِ‌ؕ يَقُوۡلُ الۡكٰفِرُوۡنَ هٰذَا يَوۡمٌ عَسِرٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Rushing towards the caller running. The disbelievers would say: ‘This is a very hard Day.’

Verses.VerseAr: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوۡحٍ فَكَذَّبُوۡا عَبۡدَنَا وَقَالُوۡا مَجۡنُوۡنٌ وَّازۡدُجِرَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The People of Nuh (Noah) also denied before this. So they belied Our servant (Nuh — Noah, the Messenger) and said: ‘(He) is mad.’ And he was given threats.

Verses.VerseAr: فَدَعَا رَبَّهٗۤ اَنِّىۡ مَغۡلُوۡبٌ فَانْـتَصِرۡ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So he prayed to his Lord: ‘I am powerless (before the transgressions of my people) so exact revenge.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَفَتَحۡنَاۤ اَبۡوَابَ السَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنۡهَمِرٍۖ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then We opened the gates of heaven with torrential rain.

Verses.VerseAr: وَّفَجَّرۡنَا الۡاَرۡضَ عُيُوۡنًا فَالۡتَقَى الۡمَآءُ عَلٰٓى اَمۡرٍ قَدۡ قُدِرَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We burst springs from the earth. So the water (of the earth and the heaven) collected for the same purpose that had been decreed already (for their destruction).

Verses.VerseAr: وَحَمَلۡنٰهُ عَلٰى ذَاتِ اَلۡوَاحٍ وَّدُسُرٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We carried him (Nuh — Noah) in the (Ark) built with planks and nails,

Verses.VerseAr: تَجۡرِىۡ بِاَعۡيُنِنَا‌ۚ جَزَآءً لِّمَنۡ كَانَ كُفِرَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Which floated before Our eyes (under Our security. All this) was done to exact revenge for him Nuh (Noah) who was rejected.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَد تَّرَكۡنٰهَاۤ اٰيَةً فَهَلۡ مِنۡ مُّدَّكِرٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely We made (the ruins of the Deluge) subsist as a Sign. So is there anyone who will think (and take advice)?

Verses.VerseAr: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِىۡ وَنُذُرِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So how My torment and My warning were!

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا الۡقُرۡاٰنَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِنۡ مُّدَّكِرٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And indeed We have made the Qur’an easy for direction and guidance, but is there anyone who will take advice?

Verses.VerseAr: كَذَّبَتۡ عَادٌ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِىۡ وَنُذُرِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (The people of) ‘Ad too rejected (the Messengers). So how (awful) My torment (upon them) and My Warning were!

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّاۤ اَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ رِيۡحًا صَرۡصَرًا فِىۡ يَوۡمِ نَحۡسٍ مُّسۡتَمِرٍّۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely We sent upon them a howling windstorm on a day of lasting evil (in their favour),

Verses.VerseAr: تَنۡزِعُ النَّاسَۙ كَاَنَّهُمۡ اَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٍ مُّنۡقَعِرٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: That plucked out people as if they were uprooted stems of date-palms.

Verses.VerseAr: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِىۡ وَنُذُرِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then how (awful) My Torment and My Warning were!

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا الۡقُرۡاٰنَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِنۡ مُّدَّكِرٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And indeed We have made the Qur’an easy for direction and guidance, but is there anyone who will take advice?

Verses.VerseAr: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُوۡدُ بِالنُّذُرِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (The people of) Thamud also rejected the Warning Messengers.

Verses.VerseAr: فَقَالُـوۡۤا اَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَاحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهٗۤ  ۙ اِنَّاۤ اِذًا لَّفِىۡ ضَلٰلٍ وَّسُعُرٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So they said: ‘Are we to follow a human being who is one of us? Then we shall certainly run into error and insanity.

Verses.VerseAr: اَءُلۡقِىَ الذِّكۡرُ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡۢ بَيۡنِنَا بَلۡ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ اَشِرٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Has the direction and guidance (Revelation) been sent down to him alone out of all of us? The truth is that he is a great liar, self-conceited (and arrogant).

Verses.VerseAr: سَيَعۡلَمُوۡنَ غَدًا مَّنِ الۡكَذَّابُ الۡاَشِرُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They will come to know tomorrow (on the Day of Judgment) who is a great liar and self-conceited (and arrogant).

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّا مُرۡسِلُوۡا النَّاقَةِ فِتۡنَةً لَّهُمۡ فَارۡتَقِبۡهُمۡ وَاصۡطَبِرۡ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Indeed We are going to send a she-camel for them to test them. So, (O Salih,) wait for their (end) and continue observing patience.

Verses.VerseAr: وَنَبِّئۡهُمۡ اَنَّ الۡمَآءَ قِسۡمَةٌ  ۢ بَيۡنَهُمۡ‌ۚ كُلُّ شِرۡبٍ مُّحۡتَضَرٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Make it known to them that water has been divided between them (and the she-camel). Everyone will be served with the share of water by his turn.

Verses.VerseAr: فَنَادَوۡا صَاحِبَهُمۡ فَتَعَاطٰى فَعَقَرَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So they called one of their companions (named Qidar). He attacked (the she-camel with a sword) and hamstrung her.

Verses.VerseAr: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِىۡ وَنُذُرِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then how (awful) My Torment and My Warning were!

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّاۤ اَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ صَيۡحَةً وَّاحِدَةً فَكَانُوۡا كَهَشِيۡمِ الۡمُحۡتَظِرِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Verily We sent upon them a terrible roar. So they became like a thatcher’s trampled stubble.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا الۡقُرۡاٰنَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِنۡ مُّدَّكِرٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And indeed We have made the Qur’an easy for direction and guidance, but is there anyone who will take advice?

Verses.VerseAr: كَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ لُوۡطٍ ۢ بِالنُّذُرِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The People of Lut (Lot) also rejected the Warners.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّاۤ اَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَاصِبًا اِلَّاۤ اٰلَ لُوۡطٍ‌ؕ نَّجَّيۡنٰهُمۡ بِسَحَرٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely We sent a windstorm raining stones upon them except the family of Lut (Lot). We saved them (from the torment) in the later part of the night,

Verses.VerseAr: نِّعۡمَةً مِّنۡ عِنۡدِنَا‌ؕ كَذٰلِكَ نَجۡزِىۡ مَنۡ شَكَرَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: With a special favour from Us. In the same way We give reward to him who gives thanks.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ اَنۡذَرَهُمۡ بَطۡشَتَـنَا فَتَمَارَوۡا بِالنُّذُرِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And no doubt Lut (Lot) warned them of Our seizure but, having doubts about his warnings, they denied.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ رَاوَدُوۡهُ عَنۡ ضَيۡفِهٖ فَطَمَسۡنَاۤ اَعۡيُنَهُمۡ فَذُوۡقُوۡا عَذَابِىۡ وَنُذُرِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And indeed they made up their minds to snatch from Lut (Lot) his guests. So We erased the structure of their eyes and stripped them of sight, then (said to them:) ‘Taste My punishment and warning.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ صَبَّحَهُمۡ بُكۡرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسۡتَقِرٌّ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely the everlasting punishment reached them early in the morning.

Verses.VerseAr: فَذُوۡقُوۡا عَذَابِىۡ وَنُذُرِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then (it was said to them:) ‘Taste My punishment and warning.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا الۡقُرۡاٰنَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِنۡ مُّدَّكِرٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And indeed We have made the Qur’an easy for direction and guidance, but is there anyone who will take advice?

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَ اٰلَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ النُّذُرُ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely the Warners came to the People of Pharaoh (as well).

Verses.VerseAr: كَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَاَخَذۡنٰهُمۡ اَخۡذَ عَزِيۡزٍ مُّقۡتَدِرٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They denied all Our Signs. Then We seized them with the seizure befitting the Glory of Almighty, All-Powerful.

Verses.VerseAr: اَكُفَّارُكُمۡ خَيۡرٌ مِّنۡ اُولٰٓٮِٕكُمۡ اَمۡ لَكُمۡ بَرَآءَةٌ فِىۡ الزُّبُرِ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (O Quraish of Makka!) Are your disbelievers better than the people (before) or has your salvation been written in the (Revealed) Books?

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ نَحۡنُ جَمِيۡعٌ مُّنۡتَصِرٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Or do these (disbelievers) say: ‘We are a strong party dominant (over the Holy Prophet [blessings and peace be upon him])’?

Verses.VerseAr: سَيُهۡزَمُ الۡجَمۡعُ وَيُوَلُّوۡنَ الدُّبُرَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Soon this party will be defeated (in the battlefield of Badr) and they will flee away turning their backs.

Verses.VerseAr: بَلِ السَّاعَةُ مَوۡعِدُهُمۡ وَالسَّاعَةُ اَدۡهٰى وَاَمَرُّ‏
Verses.VerseEn: But their (actual) promise is the Last Hour and the Last Hour is extremely terrible and most agonizing.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ فِىۡ ضَلٰلٍ وَّسُعُرٍ‌ۘ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Assuredly, the evildoers are in (the fold of) error and insanity (or Fire).

Verses.VerseAr: يَوۡمَ يُسۡحَبُوۡنَ فِىۡ النَّارِ عَلٰى وُجُوۡهِهِمۡؕ ذُوۡقُوۡا مَسَّ سَقَرَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Day when they will be dragged into Hell on their faces, (it will be said to them:) ‘Taste burning in Hell.’

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّا كُلَّ شَىۡءٍ خَلَقۡنٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely We have created everything according to a fixed measure.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَاۤ اَمۡرُنَاۤ اِلَّا وَاحِدَةٌ كَلَمۡحٍۢ بِالۡبَصَرِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Our Command comes into action once and for all as the twinkling of an eye.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ اَهۡلَـكۡنَاۤ اَشۡيَاعَكُمۡ فَهَلۡ مِنۡ مُّدَّكِرٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely We destroyed (many of) your groups. So is there anyone who will take advice?

Verses.VerseAr: وَكُلُّ شَىۡءٍ فَعَلُوۡهُ فِىۡ الزُّبُرِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And whatever they did is (recorded) in (their) Books of Deeds.

Verses.VerseAr: وَكُلُّ صَغِيۡرٍ وَّكَبِيۡرٍ مُّسۡتَطَرٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And every (action) small or big has been written.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ فِىۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّنَهَرٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Indeed the Godfearing will (rejoice) in gardens and streams,

Verses.VerseAr: فِىۡ مَقۡعَدِ صِدۡقٍ عِنۡدَ مَلِيۡكٍ مُّقۡتَدِرٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And will (be seated) in special nearness to the Sovereign Lord of (true) Power during holy sessions.
